test_strategy_focus: Targeted Red/Green command: CI=true npx vitest run apps/integrated-math-3/__tests__/lib/teacher/content-authoring apps/integrated-math-3/__tests__/convex.
Lifecycle tests must prove idempotent draft persistence and legal-only status transitions: draft -> submitted -> approved/rejected -> published with edit-after-reject.
Approval/hash tests must use real computeComponentContentHash and placement-derived example/activity/practice review contracts, including stale-hash publish rejection.
Authorization tests must prove teacher ownership, class ownership, organization boundaries, assignment, and active enrollment before student visibility/progress.
anti_pattern_coverage: A1-A10 covered in test-strategy.md §8 with per-anti-pattern defenses and falsification conditions.
nonblocking_findings: The product lifecycle includes submitted/approved/rejected, while existing lesson_versions status is draft/review/published/archived. Phase 2 tests must pin any mapping rather than silently collapse statuses.
Existing ComponentKind excludes lesson; whole-lesson publish safety should be decomposed into placed example/activity/practice approvals or be handled by an explicit contract change.
computeComponentContentHash hashes component props/grading only. If lesson/section text is publish-sensitive, Phase 2 must either include it in a documented hash contract or guard it separately.
Existing student lesson queries resolve latest published versions and are not sufficient proof of authored-content assignment/enrollment gating.
known_failures: No product tests were run or introduced in this docs-only strategy pass. Pre-existing untracked _add_types.py and _add_types.ts preserved; stash@{0} untouched.
